history: Keep each assessment and concise concrete feedback under the request attempt. Preserve raw proof evidence and accepted outputs. A repair changes only the failed source or record and reruns dependent checks; an unchanged repeated failure stops.

items.expect: The request has the shared shape and names backend.generate.

onFail.instruction: Identify the invalid request field and ask for a corrected request.

items.expect: Every declared authority and context file exists with its recorded digest.

onFail.instruction: Name the missing or changed file; do not implement from unverified authority.

items.expect: The response satisfies the operator response contract.

onFail.instruction: Repair only the response fields from verified source and artifact facts.

items.expect: The response binds this request and work revision.

onFail.instruction: Correct the response binding without reusing another request's outputs.
Remove duplicate declarations while retaining the one bound to actual evidence.

items.expect: Every file output stays in the request artifact scope and matches its digest.

onFail.instruction: Re-read actual bytes and repair the artifact or metadata; never bless changed bytes by replacing a digest alone.

items.expect: Observations name request criteria and valid evidence records.

onFail.instruction: Correct observation references from existing verified evidence.

items.expect: Implemented behavior matches the frozen contract without invented business rules.

onFail.instruction: List the exact operation or rule mismatch and repair only that implementation; ask if authority is absent.

items.expect: The diff is complete, digest-bound and contained by mutable and protected paths.

onFail.instruction: Name each out-of-bound or unaccounted path and restore or repair only those paths.

items.expect: Every required behavior proof actually ran and passed without weakening.

onFail.instruction: Report the failing command and behavior, repair its owning source, then rerun that proof and all dependent proofs.

items.expect: Required source, Git and command capabilities are available.

onFail.instruction: Return blocked with the exact unavailable capability and unfinished proof.

items.expect: Business authority, contract, boundary and proof definitions are sufficient.

onFail.instruction: Ask only for the missing authoritative input that changes implementation.

items.expect: Transient execution failures are resolved without duplicating source commits.

onFail.instruction: Inspect Git and artifact state first; retry only the incomplete idempotent command and never create a duplicate commit.

stopWhen: Return done only after every machine and review criterion passes and criteriaResults records acceptance. Otherwise return waiting, blocked or mismatch with the latest concrete feedback; stop after two feedback rounds or an unchanged repeated failure.
